defined_text = {
	# South Africa's regions are stable (mockups.STABLE); the rest consolidated or still contested
	name = SFA_GetHomeRegionStatus
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { SFA_home_region = 11 }
				check_variable = { SFA_home_region = 12 }
				check_variable = { SFA_home_region = 13 }
			}
		}
		localization_key = SFA_topbar_region_stable
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { SFA_home_region > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.SFA_consolidated^SFA_home_region = 1 }
		}
		localization_key = SFA_topbar_region_consolidated
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = SFA_topbar_region_contested
	}
}
